description:
Navigate to the cancer drug 'Brigatinib' in the Liverpool Cancer iChart Archive app. Open the co-medication category for Analgesics (Pain). Create a complete text inventory of every listed analgesic medication along with its traffic-light interaction color (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, or Grey). Save this inventory to '/sdcard/Download/brigatinib_analgesics_inventory.txt'.

The file format must be:
[Medication Name] - [Color]
...
Total: [N] medications listed
